name: wtmpprobe
description: The wtmp append path at the libc/init layer, below last(1) and ac(8).  At the prompt /etc/wtmp holds exactly two 36-byte records -- init's `~'/reboot (logwtmp(3)) and the console login login(3) appended -- so its size is 72.  The size is the assertion: 0 means nothing was appended, and anything above 72 means a stray record, the shape an unconditional session-end record took before logout(3) went back to upstream's and the end record became the caller's `if (logout(line)) logwtmp(line, "", "")'.  The marker is built by expansion (`$A$B'), so the typed line cannot satisfy it.
